newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-NZ KEEP PRESSURE ON ENGLAND IN 3RD TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NZ KEEP PRESSURE ON ENGLAND IN 3RD TEST.

text.p: New Zealand took two early wickets in the middle session of the second day's play to keep the pressure on England in the third and final cricket test at Lancaster Park on Saturday.
New Zealand were bowled out shortly after lunch for 346, with offspinner Robert Croft taking his best test figures of five for 95.

Left armer Geoff Allott then had Nick Knight and in-form Alec Stewart caught at first slip and gully respectively to give New Zealand a flying start in their bid to win the test and square the series.
Knight made 14 and Stewart 15 -- off only 10 balls -- before sparring at lifting deliveries outside their off stump.
At tea, captain Mike Atherton was on 24 and Nasser Hussain had reached 11.
Allott had taken two for 35 from seven overs.
